title: Cozy Chicken Stew with Fluffy Buttermilk Biscuit Dumplings
ingredients: 1.5 lbs cooked shredded chicken breast or thighs
1 medium yellow onion, diced; 3 carrots, sliced; 3 stalks celery, sliced
4 cups rich chicken stock + 1 cup whole milk or half-and-half
1 tsp fresh thyme, 1/2 tsp poultry seasoning, salt & black pepper
Dumplings: 1.5 cups flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1/2 tsp salt, 3 tbsp cold butter, 3/4 cup buttermilk (or 1 can flaky buttermilk biscuits, quartered)
instructions: Melt butter in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Sauté onion, carrots, and celery for 6–8 minutes, then stir in garlic, thyme, and poultry seasoning.
Sprinkle flour over the vegetables and stir 1 minute, then gradually whisk in chicken stock and milk until simmering and thickened. Fold in shredded chicken and peas.
Drop spoonfuls of the buttermilk biscuit dough (or quartered buttermilk biscuits) evenly across the top of the simmering chicken stew.
Cover tightly with a lid (or bake uncovered/covered at 375°F) for 15–18 minutes until the biscuit dumplings are puffed, golden, and cooked through.
